rows.definition: `ExpertRingEvict` is the evict symbol declared or used at `internal/model/expert_ring_hal.go:71` as `s.expertRing.policy = s.ExpertRingEvict`. This row positions that concrete implementation surface, not merely the family label.
rows.distinction: Use `ExpertRingEvict` for the operation evidenced at `internal/model/expert_ring_hal.go:71`. Unlike `x2-evict-kvevictionattestation`, it names this exact implementation surface; unlike `evict`, it is not the umbrella domain.

rows.definition: `QEvict` names the recoverable quantized KV-eviction recipe (arXiv:2608.05326v1) whose bounded trace-replay evaluation is recorded in `docs/research/quantization/qevict.md`. fak has no runtime or evaluator for it; the `internal/qevicteval` contract was removed unwired.
rows.distinction: Use `QEvict` only for that research record. Unlike `x2-evict-kvevictionattestation`, it is not a live eviction surface in fak; unlike `evict`, it is not the umbrella domain.

rows.definition: `EvictOrphans` (internal/wipinventory/evict.go:42) archives un-checkpointed orphan working-tree files into a synthetic commit under `refs/fak/quarantine/<timestamp>` and then removes them from the working tree; `fak wip evict` and the sweep path call it (cmd/fak/wip_evict.go, cmd/fak/sweep.go).
rows.distinction: It evicts FILES from a git working tree into a recoverable quarantine ref, not KV-cache, page or memory entries. Unlike `x2-evict-kvevictionattestation`, nothing about attention state is involved; unlike `evict`, it is not the umbrella domain.
